pageSummary:
Project Brief
AB InBev, one of the world's largest beverage companies, engaged us to design and implement a scalable B2B ordering portal tailored to their wholesale distribution model in Latin America and beyond. The goal was to create a multilingual, multi-brand environment that streamlined reordering for retail and hospitality customers while integrating cleanly with existing country-specific backend systems.

The platform needed to accommodate:

  • A large product catalog (e.g., Bud Light, Corona, Chelada variants)
  • User-friendly navigation for repeat buyers
  • Tiered user permissions
  • Scalable deployment per country
  • Rebate tracking and integration
  • Responsive UI optimized for in-store use

Implementation & Architecture
The technical core was built around Magento Enterprise Edition, containerized via Docker for rapid deployment across zones (e.g., USA, Mexico, Country "n"). Each country instance runs its own container stack with localized product data, pricing rules, and API logic.

Key Architecture Components:

  • Magento EE served as the eCommerce core, extended with custom AB API adapters and multi-country logic.
  • Dockerized containers allowed for quick scaling of storefronts by region.
  • Mulesoft API brokered real-time communications with country-specific mobility and ERP backends.
  • AWS Cloud Infrastructure:
    • EC2 Zones by country for logical isolation
    • Redis and RDS-backed caching and persistence layers
    • Load balancers for high availability
    • Optional Varnish layer for speed optimization
  • CloudFront CDN provided content delivery acceleration and global reach.

The front-end interface emphasized simplicity for B2B users, with a tiled visual browsing experience and mobile-friendly filtering, as shown in the Bud Light product section.

Planning & Testing

Project Planning Deliverables:

  • Template Matrix to define product presentation across brands and categories
  • UI Wireframes & Visual Style Tiles refined with AB InBev's Latin America UX team
  • Test Routine Scripts covering:
    • Container spin-up & deployment
    • Country-specific product syncs
    • Order creation & tracking
    • Role-based access
    • Multi-language switching

QA was run both in automated form and via manual test plans mapped to each country's deployment pipeline.

Outcome
The portal successfully unified ordering processes for distributors and store managers across multiple markets. By leveraging container-based deployment and centralized APIs, AB InBev gained a scalable foundation for future growth—reducing order friction and improving rebate application tracking. The system remains extensible for additional regions and product lines.

Services Provided:

  • UX Design & UI Implementation
  • Magento Customization
  • AWS Architecture & DevOps
  • API Integration (Mulesoft)
  • QA Automation & Manual Testing
